title: PSN Synergy Collector — Scanner Expansion (system_viz / prism_os / prism_ai cross-refs)
brief: MS0 first cut left 3 legs (system_viz, prism_os, prism_ai) with empty cross_refs — false-positive P0_critical pairs that drowned out real signal. This milestone eats its own dog food: ran the inspector on its own snapshot, identified the false positives, and shipped the scanners that close them.

close_out_log.note: Three new scanner functions in scripts/psn-synergy-collect.mjs: (1) `readJsonMetadataHead()` — bounded-head read of the 495MB system-graph.json that uses a stack-balanced JSON-object scanner (`extractBalancedJsonObject`) to extract `counts` / `vault` / `totals` / `coverage` sub-objects individually (the full `meta` block extends past 65KB into nested roadmap arrays). (2) `countEngineImportsInDispatcher()` — regex-counts `from .*engines/Xxx` + lazy `await import(.*engines/Xxx)` patterns in any dispatcher file. (3) `deriveSystemVizCrossRefs(meta)` — maps the graph metadata onto the 11-leg PSN as authoritative cross-refs (system_viz→engines/wiki/memories/algorithms/formulas/prism_os = N nodes of each type in the graph). Measurable delta on re-rank: P0_critical pairs 36→27 (-9), P1 3→9, P2 6→9. system_viz cross_refs went from {} to 7 real per-leg counts; prism_os→engines = 11; prism_ai→engines = 464. Also corrected system_viz node_count 280735→20702 (the previous regex `"id":` was counting substring matches inside the giant body; meta.totals.nodes is authoritative).

units.description: Iter 1 of a /loop /goal: the inspector is the steering wheel; we ran it on ourselves, it surfaced 3 collector blind spots as false-positive P0_critical pairs, and we shipped the fix. This is the canonical compounding pattern the inspector was built to enable — every chat running it can surface its own slot's gaps and ship the fix.

acceptance: scripts/psn-synergy-collect.mjs MS1 enhancement runs to completion. system_viz, prism_os, and prism_ai legs now ship populated cross_refs. Inspector re-rank shows P0_critical pair count 36→27 (9 pairs moved down a band) — measurable demonstration of the false-positive class being closed.

risks.description: The metadata-head reader uses a 64KB read with balanced-bracket scan. If the graph's `counts`/`vault`/`totals` JSON objects themselves grew past 64KB (currently <5KB), the parser would fail to find them. Mitigation: maxBytes is a parameter — bump for one-off precision runs. Real risk is low because the canonical meta block is small by design.

obsidian_brain, memories, and wiki are still under-counted in their reverse cross-refs because the collector only scans memories→wiki (via [[name]]) — not the reverse direction. Top-2 remaining P0_critical pairs (obsidian_brain↔algorithms/formulas) are likely real (memory files rarely mention bare algorithm/formula names). A future MS would add reverse-direction scanners + token-aware refs to fold these in.
